description: Illinois is at its best when people work together to solve problems and strengthen their communities. Senator Ellman believes state government should listen to working families, find practical solutions to complex problems, and be accountable to the people it serves. She believes Illinois can meet its challenges by working together and focusing on the issues that matter most to communities …
